; Calls: statements, on references, with commas and negative numbers,
; inside expressions by the signature table's arity, folded, dropped and
; unknown ones.
scn TSCallsScript
short n
ref r

begin GameMode
	MoveTo TSMarkerRef 0, 0, -100
	player.RemoveItem TSKey 1
	set n to GetItemCount TSKey
	set n to GetDistance player * 2
	set n to GetSecondsPassed
	set r to GetSelf
	set r to GetActionRef
	set r to GetLinkedRef
	set n to GetGlobalValue TSGlobalCount
	set n to GetQuestVariable TSQuest qCount
	if GetDead == 0 && GetDisabled == 0
		Disable
	endif
	r.Enable
	PlaySound TSSound
	FrobnicateWidget TSKey 3
	set n to FrobnicateWidget TSKey + 1
	set n to TSMayorRef.FrobnicateLevel
	set n to player.GetCombatThing
	set n to GetSomethingNew
	set n to TSGlobalCount + TSGlobalRate
	EVP
	Kill
	KillActor player
	PlayGroup Forward 1
	set n to GetIsSex Female
end
